feeds.title: This Is Colossal
feeds.description: This is Colossal, founded in 2010 by Chicago-based editor Christopher Jobson, is an acclaimed blog that delves into the world of art and visual culture. Renowned for its extensive coverage of contemporary art, design, photography, and visual science, the blog features 15 to 25 posts weekly, showcasing a diverse array of creative expressions. Jobson, who transitioned from web design to full-time blogging in 2013, established Colossal as part of a personal challenge to accomplish 100 things in one year...

feeds.title: Victorian Visual Culture
feeds.description: This blog provides an online forum for English 325: Victorian Literature and Visual Culture at Mount Holyoke College.

feeds.title: Visual Culture Art 218
feeds.description: Articles with thorough information on visual arts including paintings, monuments, image analysis, and more! The author - Laura Mongiovi - is an Associate Professor at Flagler College, St. Augustine, Florida.

feeds.title: Theatre & Visual Culture in the Long Nineteenth Century
feeds.description: Funded by the AHRC, this collaborative research project examines theatre spectacle and spectatorship in the long nineteenth century by considering it as a significant and integrated part of visual culture. It brings together Jim Davis, Kate Newey, Pat Smyth and Kate Holmes from the University of Warwick Theatre & Performance Studies and University of Exeter Drama departments.

feeds.title: Romantic Illustration Network » Visual Culture
feeds.description: The RIN restores to view the importance of visual culture in the Romantic period, but also across the 18th & 19th centuries. Posts about visual culture written by katiesnow11, Dr Fallon, dustinfrazierwood, and marylshannon. The RIN endorses a broad definition of illustration, welcoming interdisciplinary approaches and international perspectives which bring together scholars working on poetry, prose, the printed book, paintings and other visual materials from roughly 1750-1850.

feeds.title: Machinology » Visual Culture
feeds.description: Machines, ecology, and some media theory by Jussi Parikka. The blog talks about mechanical aspects in visual culture including instruments and technology. Jussi Parikka is a writer and professor in digital aesthetics and culture at Aarhus University.

feeds.title: Dori Griffin Blog
feeds.description: Articles on visual culture, narrative media, design history, and more. The blog is written by an art professor from Florida university.

feeds.title: Matter » Visual Culture
feeds.description: Explore the articles depicting architectural visual arts and culture. Matter. is a professional firm that aims to curate thoughtful, reflective, contemplative and sensitive work that is representative of contemporary practice in India.
